description: Place a spot limit order on a DeepBook v3 pool from your BalanceManager (fees in the input coin, no DEEP needed). Validates tick/lot/min size. Optional deposit_first funds it in the same tx. No leverage. Returns UNSIGNED tx bytes (simulated against mainnet). Non-custodial: the desk never sees or holds keys and never moves funds; it returns quotes and UNSIGNED transactions only. Spot only, no leverage. Education only, not financial advice.

balance_manager_id.description: YOUR DeepBook BalanceManager id (0x + 64 hex), from build_create_balance_manager_tx effects

deposit_first.description: Also deposit the needed coin from your wallet in the same tx

post_only.description: Post-only (maker): rejects if it would cross

sender.description: YOUR Sui address (0x...). Public address only; never send a key.

name: build_limit_order_tx
title: Build: DeepBook limit order
